prayerExcerpt.en-US: Following the lessons of her charity and prudence, may we hold fast to your teaching.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Seguindo os exemplos de sua caridade e prudência, possamos guardar os vossos ensinamentos.

meta.face: A slender woman of about sixty with a fine-boned, heart-shaped face — a wide, smooth forehead, high, soft cheekbones and a small, pointed chin; a small, straight nose with a delicate tip; warm dark-brown eyes slightly downturned at the outer corners, with soft lines at their corners; thin, dark, arched brows; a small mouth; fair skin, and a tender, motherly smile as she looks down at the child.
meta.basis: She founded the Company of St. Ursula at sixty-one and was buried in the habit of a Franciscan tertiary; the ladder vision and Desenzano are her standard iconography. No portrait from life survives (Moretto's 1540 portrait is a funeral image), so the face is an artistic choice kept apart from Monica's upturned gaze and blue mantle.
